step_assessments.description: One entry per plan step or stated dependency, judged individually. No overall verdict.

step.description: The plan step or dependency, as the plan states it.

criterion.description: The specific requirement this step is judged against, quoted from the specification.

assessment.description: Why this step does or does not satisfy that requirement.

findings.description: Concrete problems. Empty is a valid and expected result for a good plan.

what.description: What the problem actually is, in plain terms.

violated_criterion.description: The requirement this violates, quoted from the specification.

evidence.description: The passage of the plan this is based on.

solid.description: Parts of the plan that clearly satisfy a named requirement.

unverifiable_without_codebase_access.description: Claims the plan makes about existing code/assets/behaviour that could not be checked from the package alone.
